title: Minimum Cost to Merge Stones
description: Merge k consecutive piles of stones until only one remains, minimizing the total cost.
pseudocode:
1. If (n-1) % (k-1) != 0, return -1.
2. Use DP table dp[i][j] for min cost to merge stones[i...j].
3. For length len from k to n:
4.   For i from 0 to n-len:
5.     j = i + len - 1
6.     dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][m] + dp[m+1][j]) for m in steps of (k-1)
7.     If (j-i) % (k-1) == 0: dp[i][j] += sum(stones[i...j])

steps.note: Check if total reduction is possible: (4-1) % (2-1) == 0.
Merge [5,5] cost 10, final pile [10]. Total cost = 5 + 5 + 10 = 20.
